mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expected economic stimulus.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return in low-rate periods (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is negative.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return when UNRATE > 9.5% is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts below 600 thousand units and retail sales below 360,000 million dollars signal a broad-based consumer demand contraction that depresses corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return during joint demand contraction (HOUST < 600 and RSAFS < 360000) is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 96 (2017=100) signals a supply contraction that reduces manufacturing output and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during supply contraction regimes.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return during supply contraction (INDPRO < 96) is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 350,000 million dollars signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to sustained spending.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return when RSAFS > 350000 is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index level below 215 signals disinflationary pressures that reduce monetary tightening risks, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when CPIAUCSL < 215 is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Employment levels below 132,000 thousand signal labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return when PAYEMS < 132000 is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 96 (2017=100) signals a supply contraction that lowers manufacturing output and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return when INDPRO < 96 is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
